top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength lattice is a clean, general mechanism (vanishing differential ac Stark shift, Lamb-Dicke confinement of many neutral atoms) that is theoretically understood, reproduced independently at the 1e-18 level, and separable from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes if the citation names the lattice. Katori (proposal and first Sr lattice clock) and Ye (accuracy frontier and many-body clock) match two identifiable decisive contributions, so the two-name allocation is sound and a mature, well-verified achievement is preferable to no award.
